name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX6
author: Reboxed
description: 4-deck controller, from the manufacturer's MIDI mapping: pad modes (SAMPLE SCRATCH opens the sampler pads), CALL < > on loops and LOOP IN held like the DDJ-GRV6, DECK 3/4. Reboxed has one Beat FX: the multi-FX knobs 2 and 3 do nothing. Not yet tried on the hardware: report problems with the MIDI monitor (Preferences > MIDI).
